symbols.name: axis count
symbols.meaning: The number of cyclic axes, that is, of pairwise coprime lengths.
symbols.quote: Let $k$ be the number of axes.

symbols.name: axis length
symbols.meaning: The length of the i-th cyclic axis.
symbols.quote: Let $m_i$ be the length of the $i$-th axis, for $i = 1,\dots,k$, with the lengths pairwise coprime, so no two share a prime factor.

symbols.name: position count
symbols.meaning: The number of coefficient positions, the product of the axis lengths.
symbols.quote: Let $N = m_1 m_2 \cdots m_k$ be the number of coefficient positions.

symbols.name: position
symbols.meaning: A coefficient position in the sequence, an integer with $0 \le x < N$.

symbols.name: second position
symbols.meaning: A second coefficient position, added to $x$ in the wrap-around argument.

relations.quote: The Chinese-remainder map relabels the positions of a sequence by their residues modulo several lengths, and it preserves the [cyclic convolution](cyclic-convolution.md) of that sequence.
The map relabels the coefficients of a [radix-digit convolution](radix-digit-convolution.md) before any transform is computed.
